resources.string: Dose cards. The app controls alarm audio.
Notifications when alarm audio is unavailable and follow-ups for unconfirmed doses.
A reminder is active. Use its dose card.
Review the medicine and confirm your dose.
Notification without alarm audio. Open to review your dose.
Open the card to review the medicine. Silencing or snoozing does not record an intake.
Unconfirmed dose. Review your history before deciding what to do; do not double the dose.
%1$s · %2$s. Check that this is the correct dose.
Audio stops within 1 minute. Silencing or going back does not record an intake or a skipped dose.
This dose changed or has already closed. Review your history.
The action could not be saved. Try again.
The device is still locked. You can silence or snooze.
Record dose as taken. Tap or swipe to record.
No events recorded. Future reminders will appear here without medicine names or doses.
Alarm notifications: blocked. Allow notifications and check the channel.
Unconfirmed dose follow-ups: blocked. Check the reminder channel.
Timing: approximate. Notifications may be delayed and may not start alarm audio.
Lock-screen card: access allowed. Android decides when to show it.
Lock-screen card: access denied. Use the notification.
Device alarm volume, Do Not Disturb and battery restrictions can also affect reminders.
Hours after an unconfirmed dose before showing a follow-up
This setting is unavailable on your device. Check app settings.
Allow notifications to receive reminders. Exact timing and lock-screen cards are separate settings. You can continue and adjust them later in Settings.
The alarm card shows the complete dose and lets you take, skip or snooze without unlocking. This setting controls names and doses in notifications.
